addr: Jamia masjid, Whitefield Main Rd, Dodsworth Layout, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India

rev.t: Looking for quran and islamic books,then this place is for you..small shop but you will get everything.. You must try this shop.
Good for buying books, utar, but worst for stitching, they will ruin your clothes, my marriage kurtas were messed up by the tailor
Place is good for islamic book.They keep naqab nosepiece also but the black simple one. They also have Attar.
